Show a level as a beating heart filling with liquid

Source: R/heart_fill.R
heart_fill.Rd

Draws a heart filled from the bottom up to a level between 0 and 1. The liquid has a gently moving wavy surface and the heart beats. When the chart scrolls into view, the liquid rises from empty to the level and the percentage counts up with it. The percentage is written inside the heart, in white where the liquid covers it.

Usage

heart_fill(
  fill_level = 0.65,
  heart_size = NULL,
  stroke_color = "#b5172b",
  stroke_width = 3,
  fill_color = "#e63950",
  render_fill_label = TRUE,
  label_color = "#333",
  label_font_size = NULL,
  title_text = "Fill level",
  title_color = "#333",
  title_font_size = 14,
  font = "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif",
  target = NULL,
  waves = TRUE,
  beat = TRUE,
  bpm = 60,
  draggable = FALSE,
  animate = TRUE,
  bg_col = "white",
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL
)

Arguments

fill_level

A number between 0 and 1: how full the heart is (values outside are clamped). Defaults to 0.65.

heart_size

Optional. The width of the heart in pixels. By default the heart fills the space available (up to 360 pixels).

stroke_color

The colour of the outline. Defaults to "#b5172b".

stroke_width

The width of the outline. Defaults to 3.

fill_color

The colour of the liquid. Defaults to "#e63950". The empty part of the heart is a pale shade of it.

render_fill_label

Logical. Show the percentage inside the heart. Defaults to TRUE.

label_color

The colour of the percentage (where the liquid does not cover it) and of the target label. Defaults to "#333".

label_font_size

Optional. The font size of the percentage, a number or a CSS size such as "16px". By default it grows with the heart.

title_text

Optional. A caption below the heart. Defaults to "Fill level"; use NULL to hide it.

title_color

The colour of the caption. Defaults to "#333".

title_font_size

The font size of the caption, a number or a CSS size such as "14px". Defaults to 14.

font

The font family. Defaults to "Verdana, Geneva, Tahoma, sans-serif".

target

Optional. A level between 0 and 1 marked with a dashed line and a label.

waves

Logical. Animate the surface of the liquid. Defaults to TRUE.

beat

Logical. Make the heart beat. Defaults to TRUE.

bpm

The heart rate, in beats per minute. Defaults to 60.

draggable

Logical. Let the viewer change the level by dragging or with the arrow keys. Defaults to FALSE.

animate

Logical. Fill the heart from empty when it first comes into view. Defaults to TRUE.

bg_col

The background colour. Defaults to "white".

width

Optional. The width of the chart.

height

Optional. The height of the chart.

Value

An r2d3 htmlwidget.

Interactions

  • Hover the heart: it beats faster.

  • Click the heart: small hearts float up from where you clicked.

  • With draggable = TRUE, drag up or down on the heart to set the level, or focus the chart (click it or press Tab) and use the arrow keys (1 percent per press, 10 with Shift).

Shiny

Inside Shiny, with r2d3::d3Output("id") and r2d3::renderD3(), clicking the heart sets input$id_clicked to a list with value, and, with draggable = TRUE, setting a level sets input$id_value to the new level (a number between 0 and 1). When the chart is re-rendered with a new level, the liquid moves from the old level to the new one.

Examples

heart_fill(fill_level = 0.9)


heart_fill(
  fill_level = 0.4,
  target = 0.75,
  fill_color = "#ff8ab7",
  stroke_color = "#c2185b",
  title_text = "Daily activity goal"
)


heart_fill(0.55, draggable = TRUE, title_text = "Drag me")
